decision_rule: Frozen three-way rule evaluated after MEASUREMENT_INVALID check: (A) MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any MV1-MV4/MV6-MV9 mandatory gating fails: <2 genuine attempts per required durable source, missing 64-char digest or manifest SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30, pip freeze empty or version/viewport mismatch, fallback AX snapshot used, body regex absent, deterministic sampling not executed exactly as specified on BOTH primary and fallback censuses, AX_consistency not computed full-tree multi-anchor with bootstrap/trajectory-grouped, honest-cost proxy/ungrouped CI detected, or provenance missing — then no SURVIVES/FALSIFIED inference, status MEASUREMENT_INVALID. MV5 WebGym diversity clause alone defaults to UNAVAILABLE not INVALID when HF_TOKEN absent after 2 genuine attempts (marked null with attempts logged, PC-C UNAVAILABLE). (B) SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff A passes (with MV5 either PASS or documented UNAVAILABLE) AND H_A_SURVIVES: (SRC_HF_SUCCESS OR SRC_DOCKER_SUCCESS) with census artifact manifest_sha256=d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 total_tasks 700-812 (or fallback 184) families_ge3 >=30 (or fallback >=42) AND deterministic family constructibility >=10 distinct product families with product-subtree anchoring true and SHA stability both directions TRUE and CDP 1280x720 median AX>10 & median DOM>=2000 proven on canonical path families 136/145/196/222 AND full-tree multi-anchor AX_consistency mean>=0.6 bootstrap 95% CI lower>0.5 trajectory-grouped B=2000 gap>=0.20 vs shuffle p<0.05 variance>0 delta_vs_truncated>=0.20 on the >=10 family set AND WebGym diverse >=50 eTLD+1 with family-level B=2000 duplication CI non-degenerate and threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 range>=0.05 and monotonic when HF succeeds (or explicitly unavailable with 2 attempts logged) AND H_B_SURVIVES: all three external baselines B-AGENTIC-DSM/B-TRACECOMPILER-DEFUSE/B-BMEM-CATALOG executed blind on 40 alias-OOD with per-task logs, coverage point estimates + trajectory-grouped 95% CIs interior non-degenerate for DSM/ALIAS (degenerate BMEM/ROUTING/WEBMCP [0,0]/[1,1] flagged per prereg 12.7 not counted as valid), honest M_total_f10 and M_total_f100 with CIs, |rho_shuffled|<0.20, SPIDER baselines measured identically for Pareto comparison, WebMCP prevalence 0.725 CI measured amortized f10/f100, and positive controls PC-A/PC-B passed (PC-C pass when HF succeeds, otherwise UNAVAILABLE). (C) FALSIFIED_IN_SETTING if A passes but B thresholds fail after genuine attempts: durable sources 401/404 persistent, or deterministic sampling on BOTH censuses still yields only 4 product families [136,145,196,222] not >=10 (bounded FALSIFIED for 10-family gate), or AX median <=10 / SHA false / AX_consistency mean<0.6 or CI lower<=0.5 or p>=0.05 or gap<0.20 or variance==0 or delta_vs_truncated<0.20 (full-tree not achieved, remains homepage-only degenerate), or WebGym diverse <50 or sweep range<0.05 when HF succeeds, or external baselines fail blind or indistinguishable from NC1-NC4 shuffles (coverage within null CI, |rho|>=0.20, delta_vs_truncated<0.20, HITL drop<0.30, AX_consistency shuffle gap<0.20). Outcome MIXED if one module survives and the other falsified (e.g., census 4-family falsified but synthetic honest Pareto survives as in parent MIXED). All thresholds frozen; degenerate [0,0]/[1,1] and single-family AX_consistency variance 0 explicitly NOT counted as valid-width; single-source pin alone is bounded REJECTED without HF_TOKEN per do_not_assume.
